Tesla, Inc. — The investment case

Tesla, Inc. — 投资逻辑解析（工作译文）

For ordinary investors — if you are wondering whether Tesla is worth your money, here is our case.

19 Nov 2026 · 20 minutes + 10 minutes Q&A · Kai Hu, Peiyuan Qi, Woxue Li, Yuhang Fan, Tian Gao
This is the team presentation (19 Nov 2026, 20 minutes + 10 minutes Q&A) — a pitch to ordinary investors, using only simple public figures and course examples. It does not use the report’s Beta, WACC, or DCF valuation. See the team portfolio for the team introduction and preliminary thesis.

The thesis in 10 seconds

Three reasons we think Tesla is worth a closer look — the full argument is in the slides below.
01 · REVENUE

More than a car company

收入多元化

Energy, storage and services are growing alongside cars — the business is a diversified platform, not a single product line.

46.7 GWh storage deployed
02 · SCALE

Scale and automation defend share

高增长 + 运营规模

Manufacturing scale and automation lower unit cost, so growth does not have to come at the expense of margin.

03 · OPTIONS

Value is shifting from cars to options

战略期权价值

FSD, Optimus and Dojo / AI infrastructure are real options — rights, not obligations — that the car business funds.

28.4% Musk holding — interests aligned

Group 5 — Kai Hu, Peiyuan Qi, Woxue Li, Yuhang Fan, Tian Gao · BUSI4543 Corporate Finance · Team Presentation · 19 Nov 2026

Tesla, Inc. — The investment case

Tesla, Inc. — 投资逻辑解析（工作译文）

For ordinary investors — if you are wondering whether Tesla is worth your money, here is our case.

面向普通投资者——如果你正在琢磨 Tesla 值不值得投钱，这就是我们的答案。

Group 5 — Kai Hu, Peiyuan Qi, Woxue Li, Yuhang Fan, Tian Gao · BUSI4543 Corporate Finance, Team Presentation

Group 5 — Kai Hu、Peiyuan Qi、Woxue Li、Yuhang Fan、Tian Gao · BUSI4543 Corporate Finance, Team Presentation

Tesla's value is shifting from cars to options

Tesla 的价值重心正从造车转向期权（工作译文）
1
Revenue diversification — energy, services and software as a second engine
营收多元化——能源、服务和软件成为第二引擎
2
Growth at scale — cost leadership defends share in a price war
规模化增长——靠成本领先在价格战中守住份额
3
Strategic option value — FSD, Optimus and Dojo: the upside the price is paying for
战略期权价值——FSD、Optimus 和 Dojo：股价真正买单的上行空间

Our thesis in one sentence: Tesla is not only a carmaker — it is a scalable platform combining technology, energy and software, and that is why it merits investment. Today each section answers one question for you: why should an ordinary investor consider owning the stock?

一句话讲清核心观点：Tesla 不只是一家车企，它更是一个融合技术、能源和软件的可扩展平台，这也是它值得投资的原因。今天每个部分都会回答你一个问题：普通投资者为什么该考虑持有这只股票？
Speaker: Kai Hu · 0:00–1:30

More than a car company: a diversified platform

不止于造车：一个多元化的平台（工作译文）

Automotive is still the core — but energy generation and storage, services and software are becoming a genuine second engine, not a side project.

汽车业务依然是核心——但发电与储能、服务和软件正在成为真正的第二引擎，而不再只是副业。

A second engine lowers exposure to any single product cycle — that is thesis point 1, and the first reason to invest.

第二引擎能降低单一产品周期带来的冲击——这就是我们的第一个论点，也是投资的第一个理由。
Speaker: Tian Gao · 1:30–4:30

Scale and automation: a moat that defends share

规模与自动化：守住市场份额的护城河（工作译文）

Total revenue is $94,827m: automotive including services $82,056m, and energy already $12,771m.

总营收达到$94,827m：其中含服务在内的汽车业务为$82,056m，而能源业务已达$12,771m。

In a price war, the producer with the lowest unit cost can live with lower prices longest. Scale and automation are that defence — they protect volume and keep generating cash.

在价格战里，单位成本最低的厂商才能最久地扛住低价。规模和自动化就是这道防线——它们能保住销量并持续创造现金流。

If you buy Tesla, you are not buying one car cycle — you are buying a scaled producer with second engines growing behind it.

买 Tesla，买的不是一轮汽车周期——而是一家背后有第二引擎持续壮大的规模化制造企业。
Speaker: Tian Gao · 1:30–4:30

No controlling shareholder — but one dominant insider

没有绝对控股股东——但有一位举足轻重的内部人（工作译文）

Institutions hold 43.1%, the public 28.3% and insiders 28.5%.

机构持股 43.1%，公众持股 28.3%，内部人士持股 28.5%。

Elon Musk holds about 28.4% on the lecture basis, including restricted performance awards. A large insider holding means the leader's wealth rises and falls with the share price — alignment you can check for yourself.

Elon Musk 持股约 28.4%，按课上口径计算（含限制性绩效股权激励）。内部人高比例持股，意味着掌舵人的财富和股价同涨同跌——这种利益绑定是你自己就能核对的。
Speaker: Yuhang Fan · 4:30–8:00

Governance risk: real, disclosed — and monitorable

公司治理风险：真实存在、已公开披露——且可监控（工作译文）

Board oversight

7 of 9 directors are independent, with a separate compensation committee — formal monitoring exists and is checkable.

董事会监督。9 名董事中有 7 名为独立董事，且设有独立的薪酬委员会——正式的监督机制是存在且可查的。

Pledged shares

About 207.5 million of Musk's shares are pledged — a disclosed exposure a holder can monitor, not a hidden surprise.

股票质押。Musk 质押了约 2.075 亿股股票——这是已公开披露、持股人可以持续跟踪的风险敞口，不是暗雷。

Pay in court

A court struck down the $56bn pay award; Tesla reincorporated in Texas, and Musk has asked for 25% voting control. Courts and voting rules visibly push back.

薪酬诉讼。法院否决了那笔 $56bn 的薪酬方案；Tesla 随后迁册至 Texas，而 Musk 一直在争取 25% 的投票控制权。法院和投票规则都在发挥明显的制衡作用。

Our position: these agency costs are already well known to the market and priced into the decision. They are a reason to invest only money you can afford to put at risk, and to keep watching the holding — not a veto on the investment case.

我们的态度是：这些代理成本市场早就清楚，也已经计入投资决策。它们提醒我们只拿能承受风险的闲钱去投，并且持续跟踪持仓——但不会一票否决整个投资逻辑。
Speaker: Yuhang Fan · 4:30–8:00

Beta measures market risk — and only market risk

贝塔衡量市场风险——而且只衡量市场风险（工作译文）

Beta is the slope of a stock's excess returns against the market's. Above one, the stock has tended to move with the market, and by more; below one, by less.

贝塔是股票超额收益对市场超额收益回归的斜率。大于 1，说明股票倾向于跟大盘同向且幅度更大；小于 1，则波动幅度更小。

Beta is an estimate, not a precise fact — use it as a guide to sensitivity. Total risk also includes firm-specific risk, which you can reduce by holding a spread of different stocks, not just one.

贝塔只是估算值，不是精确的定数——拿它当敏感度参考就好。总风险里还包含公司特有风险，这部分风险可以通过分散持有不同股票来降低，别只押一只。

That is why one volatile stock can still be worth considering — as one part of a spread of different stocks, not your whole savings.

这就是为什么一只高波动个股依然值得考虑——前提是把它作为分散组合里的一份子，而不是押上全部身家。
Speaker: Peiyuan Qi · 8:00–11:30

From CAPM to a hurdle rate: risk must be paid for

从资本资产定价模型到门槛收益率：风险必须有回报来补偿（工作译文）
E(R) = Rf + beta x [E(Rm) - Rf]
Rf
The risk-free rate — the return for taking no market risk
无风险利率——不承担市场风险也能拿到的回报
Beta
Market sensitivity — the premium grows with beta
市场敏感度——风险溢价随贝塔增大
Hurdle
The cost of capital blends equity and after-tax debt costs — a project creates value only above it
资本成本混合了股权成本和税后债务成本——项目回报只有高于它才算创造价值

The discipline in our recommendation: higher risk is not a reason to refuse a stock, provided the expected return is high enough to pay for that risk. A volatile growth company faces a high hurdle — which protects you, the investor.

我们推荐逻辑里的核心纪律：风险高不是拒绝一只股票的理由，只要预期收益高到足以覆盖这份风险就行。高波动的成长型公司面对的门槛更高——这恰恰保护了作为投资者的你。
Speaker: Peiyuan Qi · 8:00–11:30

Options are rights, not obligations

期权是权利，不是义务（工作译文）

A locked-in commitment

Invest all the money on day one and never change your mind. A high hurdle rate then kills almost every new idea.

一锤子定死的投入。第一天就把所有钱一次性砸进去，而且再也不能反悔，这么高的门槛收益率几乎会否掉所有新想法。

Holding an option

Pay a known cost up front for the right to act later. If things go well, step in and capture the upside; if things go badly, walk away — your loss stops at your initial cost.

手握一份期权。先付一笔已知的初始成本，买下以后再做决定的权利。进展顺利就跟进投入、拿走上行收益；情况不好就直接放弃，损失停在一开始的投入上。

Uncertainty takes on a new role: bigger swings make the option more valuable, because the good outcomes can be huge.

正因为下行风险被封住、而上行空间敞开，不确定性就有了全新的作用：结果波动越大，期权反而越值钱，因为一旦成了，回报会非常可观。
Speaker: Kai Hu · 11:30–13:30

Three real options hide inside investment projects

藏在投资项目里的三种实物期权（工作译文）

Expand

A pilot can be worth doing even at negative NPV — Campusteria's expansion option was worth only $718, so the answer there was no.

扩张期权。哪怕净现值为负，试点项目也可能值得做——但 Campusteria 的扩张期权只值 $718.03，所以那个案例的答案是不做。

Delay

An exclusive right keeps its value: a drug patent was worth $37.12m even with NPV of -$150m today.

延迟期权。排他性权利本身就有价值：哪怕今天直接投的净现值是 -$150m，一项医药专利依然值 $37.12m。

Abandon

Being able to stop limits the downside — and makes the project worth more at the start.

放弃期权。能够及时止损，就封住了下行风险——这让项目在一开始就更值钱。
Speaker: Yuhang Fan · 13:30–15:00

Cybertruck to Cybercab: an abandonment option, exercised

从 Cybertruck 到 Cybercab：一次已经行权的放弃期权（工作译文）

US Cybertruck sales fell from about 39,000 in 2024 to 20,000 in 2025 — far below the 250,000 a year once expected.

Cybertruck 美国销量从大约2024 年的 39,000 辆降到 2025 年的 20,000 辆——远低于曾经预期的每年 250,000 辆。

Sunk costs should not decide. Compare the incremental value of continuing with the value of switching capacity to Cybercab. FSD and Optimus are expansion options on the same logic.

沉没成本不该决定决策。应该拿继续生产的增量价值，去和把产能转给 Cybercab 的价值做对比。FSD 和 Optimus 也是按同样逻辑算出来的扩张期权。
Speaker: Tian Gao · 15:00–17:00

Valuation direction: the price is an options question

估值方向：股价本质上是个期权问题（工作译文）

A valuation based only on selling cars cannot explain a price like Tesla's — and that is the wrong test.

光按卖车来估值，解释不了 Tesla 这样的股价——这种测试方法本身就错了。

The price pays for options not yet at scale: Robotaxi and FSD, Optimus, growing energy storage, and software attached to a large installed fleet.

股价是在为还没放量的期权买单：Robotaxi 和 FSD、Optimus、持续增长的储能业务，以及绑定在庞大车队上的软件服务。

With a right rather than an obligation, uncertainty itself can add value: the upside is open, and holders can always choose to exit. Being early can beat waiting for proof.

既然握着的是权利而不是义务，不确定性本身也能带来价值：上行空间敞开，持股人随时能选择离场。早一步进场，往往胜过苦等尘埃落定。
Speaker: Peiyuan Qi · 17:00–18:30

Our thesis, and how to look at Tesla

我们的核心观点与如何看待 Tesla（工作译文）
1

Diversification, scale, options

Energy, services and software as a second engine; cost leadership and automation defending share; and option value beyond today's cars.

多元化、规模效应、期权价值。能源、服务和软件构成第二引擎；成本领先与自动化守住市场份额；还有超越现有汽车业务的期权价值。
2

Risks understood, not hidden

Governance and market risk are real — but disclosed, monitorable and priced into the decision.

风险看得清，绝不遮掩。公司治理和市场风险真实存在——但已公开披露、可监控，并且已经计入决策。
3

How to look at Tesla

Look beyond next quarter's deliveries and ask whether today's price fairly reflects the long-term option value in autonomy, robotics, and energy storage.

该怎么看 Tesla。不妨跳出下个季度的交付数字，去思考现在的股价是不是合理反映了自动驾驶、机器人和储能背后的长期期权价值。
Speaker: Kai Hu · 18:30–20:00

Questions and discussion

提问与交流（工作译文）
